corrected_text: parts of the country that border on Italy or France, a corrupt French or Italian prevails. The two predominant religions are Calvinism and Popery. Of the former are the cantons of Zurich and Berne, the town of St Gall, Geneva, Mühlhausen, and Biel, the principality of Neufchatel, the greater part of Bail, Schaffhausen, the country of the Grisons, the Thurgau, Toggenburg, Glaris, and the Rhine valley; the frontiers of Appenzell, with a small part of Solothurn, and some places in the countries of Baden and Sargans.
